devdoc.details: This contract manages the vesting of YMT tokens.

claimFiveYearVestingTokens().details: Transfers claimable tokens to the admin address.

claimTwoYearVestingTokens().details: Transfers claimable tokens to the admin address.

claimV1RetroactiveRewards().details: Calculates the claimable amount based on the time elapsed since the distribution start, then transfers the tokens to the user's address. Any unclaimed amount from the previous claims is considered.

params.newAdmin: The address of the new admin.

params.amount: The amount of tokens to be claimed.

params.amounts: Array of claim amounts for each user.

params.ymtToken: The address of the YMT token.

devdoc.title: YMT Vesting

claimFiveYearVestingTokens().notice: Allows the admin to claim tokens from five-year linear distribution.

claimTwoYearVestingTokens().notice: Allows the admin to claim tokens from two-year vesting period.

claimV1RetroactiveRewards().notice: Allows users to claim their V1 Retroactive Rewards based on a one-year linear vesting schedule.

setAdmin(address).notice: Sets a new admin for the contract.

setClaimAmount(address,uint256).notice: Sets the claim amount for a user.

setMultipleClaimAmounts(address[],uint25.notice: Sets claim amounts for multiple users.
